lines.text: Zion's righteousness will shine like a bright light, and she will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD.
Zion will be called Hephzibah and her land Beulah, and her God will weep over her like a bridegroom.

wrong_details.wrong: her God will weep over her
wrong_details.true: her God will rejoice over her

lines.text: Watchmen are posted on Jerusalem's walls, and those who call on the LORD give Him no rest until He makes her the praise of the earth.
The LORD swears that foreigners will never again drink Zion's wine, and the call is to raise a banner for the kings.

wrong_details.wrong: raise a banner for the kings
wrong_details.true: raise a banner for the nations

lines.text: The LORD proclaims to the ends of the earth that Zion's Savior comes, and she will be called Sought Out.
